item.text:
ResStock 2025 Release 1 assigns AMY weather **by county**: all housing units within a county use the same assigned weather file.

- It selects a weather station within the county when one is available.
- Otherwise, it selects the station closest to the county’s **population centroid**, prioritizing stations in the same climate zone.
- If the station is in a different time zone, timestamps are shifted accordingly.

For AMY 2018, the pool contains **approximately 1,200 weather stations**, roughly corresponding to TMY3 station locations. The model implements the assignment through `options_lookup.tsv`, passing the weather-file parameter into `ResStockArguments`. See “Mapping Weather Files to ResStock Samples” in the [2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf).
